prompts.prompt: A manufacturing company operates an order service, inventory service, production scheduler, and product lifecycle management system. Each service owns its database, but a customer engineering change may update a part revision, reserve material, invalidate an old production order, and create a replacement order. The company cannot stop all systems for a global transaction. The architecture uses an outbox table, idempotency keys, version numbers, compensating actions, and a reconciliation worker. A change request begins in the PLM system. The PLM transaction writes the new revision and an outbox event atomically. A relay publishes the event to the message broker. Inventory creates a reservation using the event identifier as an idempotency key. The scheduler creates a new plan only when the expected part version matches. If a later service rejects the change, a compensating event releases the reservation and restores the prior plan. Every event carries a correlation identifier, causal parent, schema version, and business timestamp. Consumers keep an inbox table so duplicate deliveries do not repeat side effects. The reconciliation worker compares the authoritative revision, reservations, and plans, then emits repair commands for missing or contradictory state. Explain this architecture as a rigorous technical design. Discuss consistency boundaries, failure cases, event ordering, duplicate delivery, lost acknowledgements, schema evolution, observability, retry policy, poison messages, and how operators can prove that the system eventually converges. Continue the analysis for at least five hundred words without ending early.

한 제조 기업은 여러 고객사에 동일한 PLM 제품을 공급하지만 고객사마다 품목 속성, BOM 승인 절차, 도면 개정 규칙, 개발 단계와 양산 단계의 전환 조건이 다르다. 공통 모듈은 최대한 수정하지 않고 고객사별 확장 모듈과 설정으로 차이를 흡수해야 한다. 품목은 번호, 개정, 상태, 소유자, 생성일, 수정일을 공통 속성으로 가지며 고객사별 규격, 재질, 검사 코드와 승인 조직이 추가된다. BOM Excel 업로드에서는 작성 중인 모품만 엑셀 기준으로 재구성하고, 엑셀에서 실제 하위 레벨을 가진 모품만 기존 BOM 정리 대상이 된다. 동일 품번이 서로 다른 하위 구조를 가지면 업로드 실행 전에 검증 오류로 표시해야 한다. 양산 데이터는 승인과 권한 검증을 통과해야 하며 모든 변경은 추적 가능한 변경 이력으로 남아야 한다. 이 조건을 바탕으로 범용 PLM 기반 데이터 모델, 고객사별 메타데이터 확장, 규칙 엔진, 워크플로 오케스트레이션, Excel 검증 파이프라인, 감사 로그, 롤백 전략, 성능 최적화, 테스트 전략을 상세히 설계해줘. 단순한 항목 나열이 아니라 각 구성요소가 어떻게 연결되고 장애나 잘못된 입력이 발생했을 때 어떤 순서로 방어하는지 설명해줘. 최소 오백 단어 이상 충분히 이어서 작성하고 중간에 결론을 내리지 마.

Consider a runtime that must execute a very large transformer while only a small fraction of its data can reside on the accelerator. The runtime may stream immutable weight tiles, retain a bounded key-value cache, compile prompt-specific metadata, speculate on future tokens, and fall back to exact computation when a certificate fails. A correct design must account for physical bytes, arithmetic, synchronization, storage latency, cache replacement, quantization residuals, and the probability that a speculative path is accepted. It must not claim success from parameter counts or theoretical FLOPs alone. Define a proof-first engineering process for this runtime. Start with explicit memory, traffic, and compute inequalities. Explain how to identify hidden costs such as selector computation, residual metadata, exact repair streams, vocabulary projection, and program switching. Describe how synthetic tests differ from real operation replacement, why disjoint traces matter, how to reject an attractive but non-amortizing cache, and how to design experiments that preserve negative results. Then propose a sequence of increasingly strong evidence gates from a tiny model to a real large model. Include examples involving low-rank bases, signed error intervals, dynamic recurrence, speculative token trees, and hardware wall-clock measurement. Continue for at least five hundred words, use complete paragraphs, and do not finish the discussion prematurely.
